conclusion.observation: The same-budget branch/copy/add state family now produces nonzero unchanged-token responses from its own causal input features. These changes are consumed through the original next-layer input normalization and Q/K/V affines.
conclusion.positiveTrend: For the cube pair the H1 unchanged-token response error falls from the former zero-response baseline of 100% to 86.919%, with a strong but highly concentrated active-row response. This is actual contextual dependence, not merely a diagram or supplied native state.
countertrends: Transfer endpoint errors worsen in every port/stratum; learned-510 H1 errors rise from about38.1% to42.5%.
The two vessel pairs respond at only one unchanged-token row each; all475 unchanged padding rows still have exactly zero predicted response despite nonzero native responses.

The vessel response at row9 has only4.743% H1 error but Q/K response errors exceed100%, demonstrating that a good state-difference estimate alone does not establish a useful consumer response at the owned base.
The reused transfer pair's sole responding row has the same causal input prefix as its discovery counterpart; this is not a new row9 contextual-generalization test.
conclusion.workingInference: The new fitted tree uses causal means and thereby produces a real but specimen-dependent contextual route. It also trades endpoint accuracy for selected paired effects, leaves order-sensitive vessel propagation largely unrepresented by its selected tests, and has unseparated base/direction/finite consumer errors.

Own-base normalization, response-direction error and finite BF16 policy can interact at the next consumer.

metricScopes.caseError: Each endpoint error is normalized by its corresponding native increment from H0 at the same port and stratum. Report endpoint cosine/prediction RMS are full-port quantities, not increment alignment.
metricScopes.pairedError: Each paired response error is normalized by that pair/port/stratum's own native response RMS. Undefined cosine at zero predicted norm is retained; 100% pooled error with zero response does not assert every native row is nonzero.
metricScopes.fixedRows: All512 includes two fixed prefix cofactor rows; learned510 removes them. Active/padding and unchanged-token/unchanged-learned strata remain distinct.
metricScopes.crossPortCaution: H1/Q/K/V denominators and widths differ. A lower relative error or cosine at one port does not by itself identify attenuation/amplification of a common norm.
metricScopes.signedEnergies: Public row RMS-squared sums below are coordinate-mean energies. For a full squared-vector norm multiply by that port's width. Error=prediction+target−2alignment; signed scalar closure residuals reflect scalar reduction, not a new vector replay.
